source.text: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος, οὐκ ἀπ’ ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀλλὰ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θεοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ πάντες ἀδελφοί, ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας·

records.literal_gloss: Paul, apostle, not from men nor through man but through Jesus Christ and God Father the [one] having raised him out of [the] dead, \v 2 and the with me all brothers, to the churches of the Galatia:

en.L: Paul, an apostle, not from human beings nor through a human being, but through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and God [the] Father, who raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from [the] dead, \v 2 and all the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} with me, to the churches of Galatia:
en.B: From Paul, an apostle sent not from any human source, nor through any human go-between, but through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and God the Father, who raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead, \v 2 and from all the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who are with me, to the churches of Galatia.
en.R: This letter is from Paul, an apostle. No human group sent me out, and no person made me an apostle. Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and God the Father sent me. It was God who raised Jesus from the dead. \v 2 All the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who are here with me join me in writing to the churches in Galatia.

es.L: Pablo, apóstol, no de parte de seres humanos ni por medio de un ser humano, sino por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} y de Dios Padre, que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre [los] muertos, \v 2 y todos los hermanos [que están] conmigo, a las iglesias de Galacia:
es.B: De Pablo, apóstol, no enviado por iniciativa humana ni por medio de ningún intermediario humano, sino por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} y de Dios Padre, que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre los muertos, \v 2 y de todos los hermanos que están conmigo, a las iglesias de Galacia.
es.R: Esta carta es de Pablo, apóstol. Ningún grupo humano me envió, y ninguna persona me hizo apóstol. Fueron {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} y Dios Padre quienes me enviaron. Fue Dios quien resucitó a Jesús de entre los muertos. \v 2 Todos los hermanos que están aquí conmigo se unen a mí para escribir a las iglesias de Galacia.

sw.L: Paulo, mtume, si kutoka kwa wanadamu wala kupitia mwanadamu, bali kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na Mungu Baba, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu, \v 2 na ndugu wote walio pamoja nami, kwa makanisa ya Galatia:
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Paulo, mtume ambaye utume wake haukutoka kwa chanzo chochote cha kibinadamu, wala haukuja kupitia mtu yeyote wa kati, bali kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na Mungu Baba, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu, \v 2 na kutoka kwa ndugu wote walio pamoja nami, kwa makanisa ya Galatia.
sw.R: Barua hii inatoka kwa Paulo, mtume. Hakuna kundi la watu lililonituma, na hakuna mtu aliyenifanya kuwa mtume. Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na Mungu Baba ndio walionituma. Ni Mungu aliyemfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu. \v 2 Ndugu wote walio hapa pamoja nami wanaungana nami kuyaandikia makanisa ya Galatia.

fr.L: Paul, apôtre, non de la part des {{gender:humains|hommes}} ni par l’intermédiaire d’un {{gender:être humain|homme}}, mais par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et Dieu [le] Père, qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts, \v 2 et tous les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} [qui sont] avec moi, aux églises de la Galatie :
fr.B: De la part de Paul, apôtre envoyé non par une autorité humaine ni par un intermédiaire humain, mais par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} et par Dieu le Père, qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts, \v 2 et de la part de tous les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui sont avec moi, aux églises de Galatie.
fr.R: Cette lettre vient de Paul, un apôtre. Je n’ai pas été envoyé par un groupe humain, et personne ne m’a nommé apôtre. C’est Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} et Dieu le Père qui m’ont envoyé. C’est Dieu qui a ressuscité Jésus d’entre les morts. \v 2 Tous les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui sont ici avec moi se joignent à moi pour écrire aux églises de Galatie.

ko.L: 바울, 곧 사람들에게서 [난 것]도 아니고 사람을 통한 [것]도 아니라, 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 하나님 아버지를 통한 사도[인 나]와, \v 2 나와 함께 있는 모든 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들이 갈라디아의 교회들에게 [편지합니다].
ko.B: 사람에게서 난 것도 아니고 어떤 사람을 거쳐서 된 것도 아니라, 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 하나님 아버지께서 세우신 사도 바울과, \v 2 나와 함께 있는 모든 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들이 갈라디아의 여러 교회에 이 편지를 씁니다.
ko.R: 이 편지는 사도 바울이 보냅니다. 어떤 사람들의 모임이 나를 보낸 것이 아닙니다. 어떤 사람이 나를 사도로 세운 것도 아닙니다. 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나님 아버지께서 나를 보내셨습니다. 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 분이 바로 하나님이십니다. \v 2 여기서 나와 함께 있는 모든 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들도 나와 함께 갈라디아 지방의 여러 교회에 이 편지를 씁니다.

vi.L: Phao-lô, sứ đồ, không bởi loài người cũng không qua một người nào, nhưng qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} và Đức Chúa Trời là Cha, Đấng đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ [cõi] chết, \v 2 cùng tất cả các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} đang ở với tôi, gửi đến các Hội Thánh ở Ga-la-ti:
vi.B: Phao-lô, sứ đồ, được sai đi không phải do loài người, cũng không qua trung gian của một người nào, nhưng do Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} và Đức Chúa Trời là Cha, Đấng đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết, \v 2 cùng với tất cả các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} đang ở với tôi, kính gửi các Hội Thánh ở Ga-la-ti.
vi.R: Thư này của Phao-lô, một sứ đồ. Không có nhóm người nào sai tôi đi, và cũng không có ai lập tôi làm sứ đồ. Chính Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} và Đức Chúa Trời là Cha đã sai tôi. Chính Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Đức Giê-xu sống lại từ cõi chết. \v 2 Tất cả các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} đang ở đây với tôi cùng tôi viết thư này cho các Hội Thánh ở miền Ga-la-ti.

decisions.choice: not from human beings nor through a human being: no human source and no human go-between stands behind Paul's apostleship
alternatives: two ways of saying the same thing, with no difference between the phrases
decisions.reason: ἀπ names where something comes from, δι the one through whom it comes. Paul denies both: his commission did not start with any human authority, and no single person handed it on to him. The singular in the second phrase may answer a claim that some leader, perhaps in Jerusalem, had made him an apostle; 1:11-24 answers that claim at length.

decisions.choice: human beings in general, not men as distinct from women
decisions.reason: ἄνθρωπος is the ordinary word for a human being. The contrast here is between human and divine, not between men and women.

decisions.choice: Jesus Christ and God the Father together are the source of Paul's commission, and God is named as the one who raised Jesus
decisions.reason: One διὰ governs both names, so Paul places Jesus Christ beside God the Father as the one who sent him. He adds that the Father raised Jesus from the dead: Paul's commission came from the risen Christ (1:16; 1 Corinthians 9:1; 15:8), not from the apostles who had known Jesus before.

decisions.choice: the churches of Galatia: several congregations in the Roman province of Galatia, in central Asia Minor (modern Turkey)
alternatives: the churches in the old territory of the Galatian people in the north of the province
the churches of the southern part of the province (Pisidian Antioch, Iconium, Lystra and Derbe, Acts 13-14)
decisions.reason: The letter is addressed to a group of churches, not one city. Galatia was both the name of a people settled in the north of the region and of a larger Roman province reaching further south, and which churches Paul means cannot be settled from the letter itself. The translation is the same either way.

decisions.choice: all the brothers and sisters with me: the believers who were with Paul as he wrote, joining in the greeting
decisions.reason: Paul names no fellow sender, as he does in Philippians 1:1 and Colossians 1:1, but includes everyone with him. ἀδελφοί is masculine plural, the ordinary way to speak of a group of men and women together.

decisions.choice: Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L), Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R); {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Title and gender settings, as Colossians 1:1-2 has them.

decisions.choice: raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead
decisions.reason: Pronoun setting for Jesus.

decisions.choice: human beings; any human source; any human go-between (B); no human group, no person (R)
decisions.reason: The word means people of either sex; "men" would suggest males.

decisions.choice: This letter is from Paul ... All the brothers and sisters who are here with me join me in writing to the churches in Galatia.
alternatives: Paul, an apostle ... and all the brothers with me, to the churches of Galatia
decisions.reason: Readable turns the address into ordinary sentences, as Colossians 1:1 does, says plainly who sent Paul, and names the subject of "raised" (God) and its object (Jesus) instead of a pronoun.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}; {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1:1: for "Jesus Christ" the default is the usual Spanish name "Jesucristo", and the alternative separates name and title, "Jesús, el Mesías". Where a preposition comes before the title the span takes it in, because Spanish puts the article before "Mesías" but not before "Cristo" ("de Cristo" | "del Mesías").

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1:13 and Philippians 4:1, Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters, so there is no gender span in this letter.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no setting
alternatives: ndugu wa kiume na wa kike
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so Swahili needs no gender span in this letter, as in Romans 1:13.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives
alternatives: a span for every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1:1: Swahili marks the pronoun inside the verb ("aliyemfufua", who raised him), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, and Swahili has fewer spans than English.

decisions.choice: "du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "{{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}" for "in Christ", "Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}" at Balanced and Readable; {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The settings as Colossians 1:1-2 sets them out in French: the article stays outside the span where both "le Christ" and "le Messie" read naturally, and Paul's phrase "in Christ" carries its preposition inside the span. The churches are addressed as men and women together, with "frères" as the traditional alternative.

decisions.choice: des {{gender:humains|hommes}}, d'un {{gender:être humain|homme}} (L); une autorité humaine, un intermédiaire humain (B); personne (R), with no span
decisions.reason: The word means human beings, not men as distinct from women (m2). Literal needs a noun and so carries the setting; Balanced and Readable use French that is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: les églises, lowercase, for the congregations of a region (1:2, 1:22); l'Église de Dieu, with a capital, for God's people as a whole (1:13)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians, French marks the whole people of God with a capital and a local gathering of believers without one.

decisions.choice: the whole letter in 합쇼체 (-습니다, -십시오) at every level; the readers are "여러분"; Paul speaks of himself as "나" and "우리"; God and Christ take the honorific -시- and 께서; no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: 해라체 (-다, -라), the style of the older Korean Bibles
decisions.reason: As in the Korean of Colossians and Romans: a letter read aloud to the gathered churches calls for the formal style of a public address, so every level uses 합쇼체, even where Paul is angry, and "여러분" is the respectful plural "you". Paul writes with an apostle's authority, so he says "나" and "우리". Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change and the Korean has no deity_pronoun spans; respect for God and Christ is carried by -시-, 께서 and "그분".

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} at every level; {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 for the believers, here and through the letter
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and Romans: Korean has no article, so the christos alternative is plain "메시아", and both words end in a vowel, so the particles that follow fit either. "형제자매" (brothers and sisters) is the inclusive default for a group of believers, men and women, with "형제" as the traditional form; the plural ending "들" stays outside the span.

decisions.choice: "사람" for "human being" at every level, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the word means human beings in general. Korean "사람" already means a person of either sex, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change, here and wherever the letter speaks of "people".

decisions.choice: "tôi" for Paul, "chúng tôi" for Paul and those with him, "chúng ta" where the readers are included, and "anh chị em" for "you" (plural) through the whole letter
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians and Romans, Paul is "tôi" and the churches are "anh chị em", the warm, inclusive form Vietnamese churches use. Paul is the founder of these churches and in 4:19 calls them his children, but through the rest of the letter he argues with them as brothers and sisters (1:11; 3:15; 4:12), so "anh chị em" is kept and "các con" is used only in 4:19. "Anh chị em" for "you" is plain text; the gender span is kept for the word adelphoi.

decisions.choice: Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} for "Jesus Christ"; {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu (L), Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} (B, R) for "Christ Jesus"; {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} for "Christ" alone (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The forms set in the Vietnamese Colossians and Romans: Literal follows the Greek order, Balanced and Readable put the name first; "Đấng" makes Christ a title, as "the" does in English, and with "Lord" the honorific "Đức" gives way to "Chúa".

decisions.choice: "Hội Thánh" for the church at every level; "Ga-la-ti" for Galatia
decisions.reason: "Hội Thánh" is the word the Vietnamese Colossians and Romans use for the church, a local congregation or the whole people of God. Names follow the Protestant transliterations, as the style guide sets.

source.text: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, τοῦ δόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ὅπως ἐξέληται ἡμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ αἰῶνος τοῦ ἐνεστῶτος πονηροῦ κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: grace to you and peace from God Father and Lord of us Jesus Christ, \v 4 the [one] having given himself for the sins of us so that he might deliver us out of the age the present evil according to the will of the God and Father of us, \v 5 to whom the glory to the ages of the ages; amen.

en.L: Grace to you and peace from God [the] Father and our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 4 who gave {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} for our sins so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might rescue us out of the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father, \v 5 to whom [be] the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.
en.B: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, \v 4 who gave {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} for our sins to rescue us from this present evil age, as our God and Father willed. \v 5 To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
en.R: May God our Father and our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} show you grace and give you peace. \v 4 Jesus gave {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} to die for our sins. He did it to rescue us from the evil age we live in now. This was what our God and Father wanted. \v 5 May God receive glory forever and ever! Amen.

es.L: Gracia a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y paz de Dios Padre y de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, \v 4 que se dio a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} por nuestros pecados para librarnos de la presente era mala, según la voluntad de nuestro Dios y Padre, \v 5 a quien [sea] la gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
es.B: Gracia y paz a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de parte de Dios Padre y de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, \v 4 que se entregó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} por nuestros pecados para rescatarnos de esta era presente y malvada, como lo quiso nuestro Dios y Padre. \v 5 A {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sea la gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
es.R: Que Dios nuestro Padre y nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} {{plural_you:les|os}} den gracia y paz. \v 4 Jesús se dio a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} para morir por nuestros pecados. Lo hizo para rescatarnos de esta era malvada en que vivimos ahora. Eso era lo que quería nuestro Dios y Padre. \v 5 ¡Que Dios reciba la gloria por siempre! Amén.

sw.L: Neema kwenu na amani kutoka kwa Mungu Baba na Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 4 aliyejitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu ili atuokoe kutoka katika zama hizi za sasa zilizo mbovu, kwa kadiri ya mapenzi ya Mungu na Baba yetu, \v 5 ambaye kwake [uwe] utukufu milele na milele. Amina.
sw.B: Neema na amani ziwe nanyi kutoka kwa Mungu Baba na Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 4 aliyejitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, ili atuokoe kutoka katika zama hizi mbovu za sasa, kama Mungu na Baba yetu alivyopenda. \v 5 Utukufu uwe {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} milele na milele. Amina.
sw.R: Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wawape neema na amani. \v 4 Yesu alijitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} afe kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu. Alifanya hivyo ili atuokoe kutoka katika zama hizi mbovu tunazoishi sasa. Hivyo ndivyo Mungu na Baba yetu alivyotaka. \v 5 Mungu na apewe utukufu milele na milele! Amina.

fr.L: Grâce à vous et paix de la part de Dieu [le] Père et de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, \v 4 qui s’est donné {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour nos péchés afin de nous arracher au présent âge mauvais, selon la volonté de notre Dieu et Père, \v 5 à qui [soit] la gloire aux siècles des siècles. Amen.
fr.B: Grâce et paix à vous de la part de Dieu le Père et de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, \v 4 qui s’est donné {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour nos péchés afin de nous arracher à cet âge présent et mauvais, comme l’a voulu notre Dieu et Père. \v 5 À {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} soit la gloire pour les siècles des siècles. Amen.
fr.R: Que Dieu notre Père et notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} vous donnent la grâce et la paix. \v 4 Jésus s’est donné {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour mourir à cause de nos péchés. Il l’a fait pour nous délivrer de cette époque mauvaise où nous vivons maintenant. C’est ce que voulait notre Dieu et Père. \v 5 Que Dieu reçoive la gloire pour toujours ! Amen.

ko.L: 하나님 아버지와 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께로부터 은혜와 평안이 여러분에게 [있기를 빕니다]. \v 4 그분은 우리 죄를 위하여 자기 자신을 내주셨으니, 우리 하나님 아버지의 뜻을 따라 이 악한 현세대에서 우리를 건져 내시려는 것이었습니다. \v 5 그분께 영광이 영원무궁하도록 [있기를 빕니다]. 아멘.
ko.B: 하나님 아버지와 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분에게 은혜와 평안을 주시기를 빕니다. \v 4 그분은 우리 하나님 아버지의 뜻을 따라, 우리 죄 때문에 자신을 내주셔서 지금의 이 악한 세대에서 우리를 건져 내셨습니다. \v 5 그분께 영광이 영원히 있기를 빕니다. 아멘.
ko.R: 우리 아버지 하나님과 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분에게 은혜를 베푸시고 평안을 주시기를 빕니다. \v 4 예수께서는 우리 죄 때문에 자신을 내주셔서 죽으셨습니다. 지금 우리가 사는 이 악한 세상에서 우리를 구해 내시려고 그렇게 하셨습니다. 그것이 우리 아버지 하나님께서 원하신 일이었습니다. \v 5 하나님께서 영원히 영광을 받으시기를 빕니다! 아멘.

vi.L: Ân điển và bình an cho anh chị em từ Đức Chúa Trời là Cha và Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, \v 4 là Đấng đã phó chính mình vì tội lỗi chúng ta để giải cứu chúng ta ra khỏi thời đại gian ác hiện nay, theo ý muốn của Đức Chúa Trời và Cha chúng ta, \v 5 nguyện vinh quang [thuộc về] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời vô cùng. A-men.
vi.B: Nguyện ân điển và bình an từ Đức Chúa Trời là Cha và từ Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} ở cùng anh chị em. \v 4 Ngài đã phó chính mình vì tội lỗi chúng ta để giải cứu chúng ta khỏi thời đại gian ác hiện nay, theo ý muốn của Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta. \v 5 Nguyện vinh quang thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời vô cùng. A-men.
vi.R: Cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, và Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} ban ân điển và bình an cho anh chị em. \v 4 Đức Giê-xu đã hiến dâng chính mình, chịu chết vì tội lỗi chúng ta. Ngài làm vậy để giải cứu chúng ta khỏi thời đại gian ác mà chúng ta đang sống. Đó là điều Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, muốn. \v 5 Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời được tôn vinh đời đời! A-men.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ"
alternatives: "from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ over where ἡμῶν ("our") stands: after "Lord", as SBLGNT has it, or after "Father", as in Paul's usual greeting (Philippians 1:2). Both are well attested. Either way grace and peace come from the Father and from Jesus Christ, and the meaning is not changed.

decisions.choice: who gave himself for our sins: Jesus gave up his life to deal with our sins
alternatives: gave himself up to suffering in general
decisions.reason: "Gave himself" means he gave his life, as in 2:20 ("who loved me and gave himself for me"). ὑπὲρ with "sins" means on account of them, to take them away, as in 1 Corinthians 15:3 ("Christ died for our sins"). Paul puts the cross at the front of the letter before he says anything else.

decisions.choice: the present evil age: the present time of the world, in which evil holds sway, set against the age to come
decisions.reason: αἰών is an age, a period of history. Jewish teaching spoke of "this age" and "the age to come"; Paul says Christ's death already sets believers free from the hold of the present age, though they still live in it (6:14-15 speaks of a new creation). It is not the created world that is evil, but the age under the power of sin.

decisions.choice: according to the will of our God and Father: Christ's self-giving and the rescue it brings were what the Father willed
alternatives: the phrase goes only with "rescue us"
decisions.reason: The phrase closes the whole clause: Christ's giving himself and its purpose both carry out the Father's plan. The Son acts with the Father, not against him.

decisions.choice: to whom: to God the Father, to whom glory belongs for ever
decisions.reason: ᾧ looks back to the nearest name, "our God and Father". The verb is left out, as is usual in such praise: "[be]" or "[is]". The repeated "ages of the ages" is a Hebrew way of saying "for ever".

decisions.choice: Amen: a Hebrew word of agreement, "so be it"
decisions.reason: ἀμήν is a Hebrew word carried into Greek unchanged. A congregation hearing the letter read would answer the praise with it.

decisions.choice: Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L), Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R); {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}
decisions.reason: Title and pronoun settings.

decisions.choice: age
decisions.reason: "Age" keeps the sense of a period of time and the contrast with the age to come; "world" would suggest the created world, and is kept in this translation for a different Greek word.

decisions.choice: Jesus gave {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} to die for our sins
alternatives: who gave himself for our sins
decisions.reason: Readable says that Jesus gave himself up to death, which is what "gave himself" means here (2:20).

decisions.choice: May God our Father and our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} show you grace and give you peace. ... May God receive glory forever and ever!
alternatives: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: Readable makes the greeting and the praise into prayers, as Colossians 1:2 does, and names God instead of "to whom".

decisions.choice: to the ages of the ages (L); for ever and ever (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew-style phrase; Balanced uses the English phrase with the same force.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the Galatian churches in the plural throughout the letter. Each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain), as in Romans.

decisions.choice: "era" for the present evil age; "por los siglos de los siglos" (L, B), "por siempre" (R) in the praise
decisions.reason: In modern Spanish "siglo" is a century, and "mundo" would suggest the created world, which the meaning decision rules out. "Era" keeps the sense of a period of history. In the praise the same Greek word stands in a fixed phrase, and Spanish has its own fixed phrase for it, as in Philippians 4:20.

decisions.choice: "zama" for the present evil age; "milele na milele" in the praise
decisions.reason: "Ulimwengu" is the world, which the meaning decision rules out; "zama" is an age or era, a period of history. In the praise the same Greek word stands in a fixed phrase for "for ever", and Swahili says "milele na milele" at Literal too, since "zama za zama" is not Swahili.

decisions.choice: âge (L, B); époque (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a period of history set against the age to come (m3). "Siècle" is the older French Bible word but today means a hundred years, and "monde" would suggest the created world. The fixed phrase of praise in verse 5 keeps its familiar French form, "aux siècles des siècles".

decisions.choice: "현세대" (L); "지금의 이 악한 세대" (B); "지금 우리가 사는 이 악한 세상" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as an age, the present time of the world set against the age to come. "세대" (an era) keeps that at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "세상", the world as people now live in it, which is what the English Readable means by "the evil age we live in now". "세상" stays the word for the world as a place elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "영원무궁하도록" (L); "영원히" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says "to the ages of the ages", a way of saying "for ever". "영원무궁하도록" (for ever and without end) keeps the doubled phrase at Literal; "세세토록" is older church language.

decisions.choice: "thời đại gian ác hiện nay" (L, B); "thời đại gian ác mà chúng ta đang sống" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is an age, a span of time set against the age to come (m3), so "thời đại"; "thế gian" is kept for the world (kosmos).

decisions.choice: "A-men"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is kept in the form Vietnamese churches say it, as in the Vietnamese Romans (m6).

source.text: Θαυμάζω ὅτι οὕτως ταχέως μετατίθεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐν χάριτι Χριστοῦ εἰς ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον, ὃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλο· εἰ μή τινές εἰσιν οἱ ταράσσοντες ὑμᾶς καὶ θέλοντες μεταστρέψαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: I am astonished that so quickly you are deserting from the [one] having called you in [the] grace of Christ to a different gospel, \v 7 which not is another; except some are the [ones] troubling you and wanting to distort the gospel of the Christ.

en.L: I am astonished that you are so quickly turning away from the one who called you in [the] grace of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, to a different gospel, \v 7 which is not another [gospel]; except that there are some who are troubling you and want to distort the gospel of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: I am astonished that you are so quickly turning away from God, who called you by the grace of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and going over to a different gospel. \v 7 But there is no second gospel. There are only some people who are unsettling you and want to twist the gospel of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} into something else.
en.R: I am shocked that you are so quickly turning away from God. He called you through the grace of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. But now you are turning to a different kind of good news. \v 7 Really, there is no other good news. But some people are confusing you. They want to change the good news about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} into something else.

es.L: Me asombro de que tan rápido {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} desertando del que {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó en [la] gracia {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} hacia un evangelio diferente, \v 7 que no es otro [evangelio]; solo que hay algunos que {{plural_you:los|os}} inquietan y quieren torcer el evangelio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.B: Me asombra que tan pronto {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} abandonando a Dios, que {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó por la gracia {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, y {{plural_you:se estén|os estéis}} pasando a un evangelio diferente. \v 7 Pero no existe un segundo evangelio. Lo único que hay son algunas personas que {{plural_you:los|os}} inquietan y quieren torcer el evangelio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} para convertirlo en otra cosa.
es.R: Me sorprende mucho que tan pronto {{plural_you:se estén|os estéis}} alejando de Dios. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó por medio de la gracia {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. Pero ahora {{plural_you:se están|os estáis}} volviendo hacia otra clase de buena noticia. \v 7 En realidad, no hay otra buena noticia. Pero algunas personas {{plural_you:los|os}} están confundiendo. Quieren convertir la buena noticia acerca {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} en otra cosa.

sw.L: Ninashangaa kwamba upesi hivi mnahama kutoka kwa yule aliyewaita katika neema ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwenda kwenye Injili tofauti, \v 7 ambayo si [Injili] nyingine; isipokuwa wapo watu fulani wanaowavuruga na wanaotaka kuipotosha Injili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Ninashangaa kwamba upesi hivi mnamwacha Mungu aliyewaita kwa neema ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mkahamia Injili tofauti. \v 7 Lakini hakuna Injili ya pili. Kuna watu fulani tu wanaowavuruga, nao wanataka kuipotosha Injili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} iwe kitu kingine.
sw.R: Nashangaa sana kwamba mnamwacha Mungu upesi hivi. Yeye aliwaita kupitia neema ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Lakini sasa mnageukia habari njema ya aina nyingine. \v 7 Kwa kweli, hakuna habari njema nyingine. Lakini watu fulani wanawachanganya. Wanataka kuibadilisha Habari Njema kuhusu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} iwe kitu kingine.

fr.L: Je m’étonne que si vite vous vous détourniez de celui qui vous a appelés dans la grâce du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, vers un évangile différent, \v 7 qui n’en est pas un autre ; sinon qu’il y a des gens qui vous troublent et qui veulent dénaturer l’Évangile du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Je suis stupéfait que vous vous détourniez si vite de Dieu, qui vous a appelés par la grâce du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, pour passer à un évangile différent. \v 7 Mais il n’y a pas de second évangile. Il y a seulement des gens qui jettent le trouble parmi vous et qui veulent faire de l’Évangile du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} autre chose.
fr.R: Je suis choqué de voir que vous vous détournez si vite de Dieu. Il vous a appelés par la grâce du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Mais maintenant, vous vous tournez vers une autre sorte de bonne nouvelle. \v 7 En réalité, il n’y a pas d’autre bonne nouvelle. Mais certaines personnes sèment la confusion parmi vous. Elles veulent changer la bonne nouvelle qui parle du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} en autre chose.

ko.L: 나는 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 은혜 안에서 여러분을 부르신 분에게서 이렇게 빨리 떠나 다른 복음으로 옮겨 가고 있다는 것에 놀랍니다. \v 7 그것은 다른 [복음]이 아닙니다. 다만 여러분을 혼란에 빠뜨리고 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 복음을 왜곡하려는 어떤 사람들이 있을 뿐입니다.
ko.B: 나는 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 은혜로 여러분을 부르신 하나님을 이렇게 빨리 떠나서 다른 복음으로 넘어가고 있다는 것에 놀랐습니다. \v 7 그러나 두 번째 복음이란 없습니다. 다만 어떤 사람들이 여러분을 뒤흔들어 놓고 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 복음을 전혀 다른 것으로 뒤틀려고 할 뿐입니다.
ko.R: 여러분이 이렇게 빨리 하나님을 떠나고 있다니 나는 정말 놀랐습니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 은혜로 여러분을 부르셨습니다. 그런데 지금 여러분은 다른 기쁜 소식으로 옮겨 가고 있습니다. \v 7 사실 다른 기쁜 소식이란 없습니다. 그런데 어떤 사람들이 여러분을 혼란스럽게 하고 있습니다. 그들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 관한 기쁜 소식을 다른 것으로 바꾸려고 합니다.

vi.L: Tôi lấy làm kinh ngạc vì anh chị em đã vội lìa bỏ Đấng đã gọi anh chị em trong ân điển của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} như vậy, mà theo một tin lành khác, \v 7 vốn không phải là [Tin Lành] khác; chỉ là có mấy người đang quấy rối anh chị em và muốn bóp méo Tin Lành của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Tôi rất kinh ngạc vì anh chị em đã vội vàng lìa bỏ Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã gọi anh chị em bởi ân điển của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, để chạy theo một tin lành khác. \v 7 Thật ra chẳng có tin lành nào khác cả. Chỉ là có một số người đang làm anh chị em xáo trộn và muốn xuyên tạc Tin Lành của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Tôi thật sửng sốt khi thấy anh chị em đã nhanh chóng quay lưng lại với Đức Chúa Trời như vậy. Ngài đã gọi anh chị em đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua ân điển của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Thế mà bây giờ anh chị em lại chạy theo một thứ tin lành khác. \v 7 Thật ra không có tin lành nào khác. Nhưng có một số người đang làm anh chị em bối rối. Họ muốn biến Tin Lành về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} thành một điều gì khác.

decisions.choice: Paul goes straight from the greeting to his astonishment, with no thanksgiving
decisions.reason: In his other letters Paul thanks God for the readers after the greeting (Philippians 1:3; Colossians 1:3). Here the thanksgiving is missing, and the first word after the greeting is a rebuke. The letter's hearers would notice the gap.

decisions.choice: the one who called you is God
decisions.reason: Paul regularly speaks of God as the one who calls (1:15; 5:8; Romans 8:30). The participle καλέσαντος stands without a name, but the same verb in 1:15 has God as its subject.

decisions.choice: in the grace of Christ: God called them by means of Christ's grace, and into it
alternatives: called you into the grace of Christ (the place they were called to)
called you in grace (no reference to how)
decisions.reason: ἐν can mark the means ("by") or the sphere ("in"). The two belong together here: the grace Christ gives is both how they were called and what they were called to share. The levels keep "in" or "by" without narrowing it further.

decisions.choice: turning away: deserting one side for another, and still in progress
alternatives: being moved by others (a true passive)
decisions.reason: μετατίθημι was used of soldiers or officials who changed sides. The present tense shows that the desertion is happening as Paul writes and is not yet complete; the letter is written to stop it. The form could be passive ("you are being moved"), but Paul holds the Galatians responsible (3:1-3).

decisions.choice: a different gospel, which is not another gospel: the message they are turning to differs in kind and is no gospel at all
alternatives: a sharp distinction between two Greek words for "other" is meant
decisions.reason: Paul calls it a ἕτερον gospel and at once denies that there is any ἄλλο: he grants it the name only to take it back. The point does not rest on a fixed difference between the two words, which overlap in meaning, but on the denial. There is only one gospel (1:8-9).

decisions.choice: except that: the only thing there is besides the gospel is people unsettling you and trying to twist it
decisions.reason: εἰ μή ("except") qualifies the denial: there is no other gospel; there are only people who trouble the Galatians. ταράσσοντες is the word Paul uses of these teachers again in 5:10, and μεταστρέψαι means to turn something into its opposite.

decisions.choice: grace of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, gospel of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article the Greek has before the second title.

decisions.choice: God, who called you (B); turning away from God. He called you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God, the one Paul means (m2), since "the one who called you" leaves many readers unsure.

decisions.choice: twist ... into something else (B); change ... into something else (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn something into something different; "pervert" now has other associations in English.

decisions.choice: a different kind of good news
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the difference is one of kind (m5).

decisions.choice: desertando (L); abandonando ... pasando a (B); alejando (R)
decisions.reason: The verb was used of changing sides (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps that picture with "desertar"; Balanced says both halves of the move, leaving God and going over to another message; Readable uses the everyday "alejarse".

decisions.choice: kuhama (L); kumwacha ... kuhamia (B)
decisions.reason: "Kuhama" is to move away or change one's allegiance, which fits the picture of deserting one side for another (m4). Readable says "mnamwacha" and "mnageukia", plain words for leaving and turning to.

decisions.choice: l'Évangile (L, B), la bonne nouvelle (R); "un évangile différent", lowercase, for the other message (for the whole letter)
alternatives: la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: the capital marks the one message from God, and Readable says "bonne nouvelle" because "Évangile" is church language. The rival message is written without the capital, since Paul grants it the name only to take it back (m5). The verb "preach the gospel" is "annoncer l'Évangile" (L, B) and "annoncer la bonne nouvelle" (R).

decisions.choice: dénaturer (L)
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn something into something else (m6). "Pervertir" now suggests moral corruption, as "pervert" does in English.

decisions.choice: "복음" (L, B); "기쁜 소식" (R), here and through the letter
decisions.reason: "복음" is the established church word for the gospel; Readable says "기쁜 소식", as the English Readable says "good news", because "복음" is church language. The same words are used in Colossians and Romans.

decisions.choice: "하나님" named as the one who called (B, R)
alternatives: "부르신 분" (the one who called) at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the one who called them is God; Balanced and Readable name him, as the English does, and Literal keeps the Greek's "부르신 분".

decisions.choice: "Tin Lành" for the gospel at every level, Readable included; "một tin lành khác", lowercase, for the other message
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians (1:5) and Romans, "Tin Lành" already means "good news", so Readable keeps it. The false message is written in lower case, since Paul says it is no gospel at all (m5).

decisions.choice: "lìa bỏ" (L, B); "quay lưng lại với" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to desert one side for another (m4). "Lìa bỏ" is to leave someone one belonged to, and keeps the sense that they are leaving God, not only a teaching.

source.text: ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐὰν ἡμεῖς ἢ ἄγγελος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εὐαγγελίζηται ὑμῖν παρ’ ὃ εὐηγγελισάμεθα ὑμῖν, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.

records.literal_gloss: But even if we or an angel out of heaven should preach-the-gospel to you contrary to what we preached-the-gospel to you, accursed let him be.

en.L: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel to you contrary to what we preached to you, let that one be accursed.
en.B: But even if we ourselves, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let that one be under God's curse.
en.R: But suppose we ourselves, or even an angel from heaven, told you good news that is different from the good news we told you. Then may God's curse fall on them!

es.L: Pero aun si nosotros o un ángel del cielo {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciara un evangelio contrario al que {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciamos, quede bajo maldición.
es.B: Pero aun si nosotros mismos, o un ángel del cielo, {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciara un evangelio distinto del que {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciamos, quien lo haga quede bajo la maldición de Dios.
es.R: Supongamos que alguno de nosotros, o incluso un ángel del cielo, {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciara una buena noticia diferente de la que {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciamos. ¡Entonces, que la maldición de Dios caiga sobre quien lo haga!

sw.L: Lakini hata kama sisi au malaika kutoka mbinguni angewahubiria Injili iliyo kinyume na ile tuliyowahubiria, na alaaniwe.
sw.B: Lakini hata kama sisi wenyewe, au malaika kutoka mbinguni, angewahubiria Injili tofauti na ile tuliyowahubiria, huyo na awe chini ya laana ya Mungu.
sw.R: Lakini tuseme sisi wenyewe, au hata malaika kutoka mbinguni, angewaambia habari njema iliyo tofauti na Habari Njema tuliyowaambia. Basi laana ya Mungu na imwangukie huyo!

fr.L: Mais même si nous, ou un ange du ciel, vous annoncions un évangile contraire à celui que nous vous avons annoncé, qu’il soit maudit.
fr.B: Mais même si nous-mêmes, ou un ange venu du ciel, nous vous annoncions un évangile autre que celui que nous vous avons annoncé, que celui-là soit sous la malédiction de Dieu.
fr.R: Imaginez que nous-mêmes, ou même un ange venu du ciel, nous vous annoncions une bonne nouvelle différente de celle que nous vous avons annoncée. Alors, que la malédiction de Dieu tombe sur celui qui le fait !

ko.L: 그러나 우리나 하늘에서 온 천사라도 우리가 여러분에게 전한 것과 다른 복음을 여러분에게 전한다면, 그 사람은 저주를 받아야 합니다.
ko.B: 그러나 우리 자신이든 하늘에서 온 천사든, 우리가 여러분에게 전한 복음과 다른 복음을 여러분에게 전한다면, 그 사람은 하나님의 저주 아래 놓여야 합니다.
ko.R: 우리 자신이나, 심지어 하늘에서 온 천사가 우리가 전한 기쁜 소식과 다른 기쁜 소식을 여러분에게 전한다고 해 봅시다. 그러면 하나님의 저주가 그에게 내리기를 바랍니다!

vi.L: Nhưng dù chính chúng tôi hoặc một thiên sứ từ trời rao giảng cho anh chị em một tin lành trái với điều chúng tôi đã rao giảng cho anh chị em, người ấy phải bị nguyền rủa.
vi.B: Nhưng dù chính chúng tôi, hay một thiên sứ từ trời, rao giảng cho anh chị em một tin lành khác với Tin Lành chúng tôi đã rao giảng cho anh chị em, thì người ấy phải chịu sự nguyền rủa của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Giả sử chính chúng tôi, hoặc ngay cả một thiên sứ từ trời, nói với anh chị em một tin lành khác với Tin Lành chúng tôi đã nói cho anh chị em. Nếu vậy, nguyện sự nguyền rủa của Đức Chúa Trời đổ trên người ấy!

decisions.choice: even if: a case Paul does not expect, put as strongly as possible
decisions.reason: ἐὰν with the subjunctive sets out a supposition. Paul names the most trustworthy messengers he can think of, himself and his companions or an angel from heaven, to show that the message matters more than the messenger.

decisions.choice: contrary to: any gospel other than the one Paul preached, which by being other opposes it
alternatives: in addition to (adding something to Paul's gospel)
decisions.reason: παρ with the accusative can mean "against" or "beside, beyond". In Galatians the two come to the same thing: the teachers wanted to add circumcision and the law to the gospel (5:2-4), and that addition changed it into another message.

decisions.choice: accursed: placed under God's curse, handed over to his judgment
alternatives: excluded from the church (church discipline only)
decisions.reason: In the Greek Old Testament ἀνάθεμα is something devoted to God for destruction (Leviticus 27:28-29; Joshua 6:17). Paul uses it for being cut off from Christ (Romans 9:3; 1 Corinthians 16:22). The curse is in God's hands; Paul is not calling on the church to carry it out.

decisions.choice: let that one be accursed (L); let that one be under God's curse (B); may God's curse fall on them (R)
decisions.reason: "Anathema" is not current English. Balanced and Readable say whose curse it is (m3) without deciding more than the word says.

decisions.choice: that one; them
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject, and Paul includes himself, his companions and any messenger; "that one" and "them" do not limit it to a man.

decisions.choice: But suppose ... Then may God's curse fall on them!
alternatives: But even if we or an angel from heaven ...
decisions.reason: Readable splits the condition and the curse into two sentences.

decisions.choice: quede bajo maldición (L); quien lo haga quede bajo la maldición de Dios (B); que la maldición de Dios caiga sobre quien lo haga (R)
decisions.reason: "Anatema" is a church word few readers know. "Sea maldito" would make the one cursed masculine, while Paul includes himself, his companions and an angel; "quedar bajo maldición" and "quien lo haga" leave the subject open, as the English "that one" does.

decisions.choice: qu'il soit maudit (L); que celui-là soit sous la malédiction de Dieu (B); que la malédiction de Dieu tombe sur celui qui le fait (R); the same in 1:9
decisions.reason: "Anathème" is church language few readers know. Balanced and Readable say whose curse it is (m3). The generic "il", "celui-là" and "celui qui" include Paul, his companions and any messenger, and need no gender setting.

decisions.choice: "저주를 받아야 합니다" (L); "하나님의 저주 아래 놓여야 합니다" (B); "하나님의 저주가 그에게 내리기를 바랍니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means handed over to God's curse (the meaning decision). Korean says it plainly in the letter's 합쇼체; the archaic "-을지어다" of the older Bibles is not used. Balanced and Readable name God, as the English does. "그 사람" and "그" stand for anyone of either sex, as Korean "그" can.

decisions.choice: "bị nguyền rủa" (L); "chịu sự nguyền rủa của Đức Chúa Trời" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means handed over to God's judgment (m3), as in the Vietnamese Romans (9:3). "Rủa sả" is older church language, and "dứt phép thông công" names a later church discipline.

decisions.choice: "chúng tôi" for Paul and his fellow missionaries
decisions.reason: The readers are not among those who preached to them, so Vietnamese uses the exclusive "chúng tôi".

source.text: ὡς προειρήκαμεν, καὶ ἄρτι πάλιν λέγω, εἴ τις ὑμᾶς εὐαγγελίζεται παρ’ ὃ παρελάβετε, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.

records.literal_gloss: As we have said before, and now again I say, if anyone you preaches-a-gospel contrary to what you received, accursed let him be.

en.L: As we have said before, so now I say again: if anyone is preaching a gospel to you contrary to what you received, let that one be accursed.
en.B: We have said it before, and now I say it again: if anyone preaches to you a gospel other than the one you received, let that one be under God's curse.
en.R: We told you this before, and now I am telling you again. If anyone tells you good news that is different from the good news you accepted, may God's curse fall on them!

es.L: Como hemos dicho antes, también ahora digo otra vez: si alguien {{plural_you:les|os}} está anunciando un evangelio contrario a lo que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}, quede bajo maldición.
es.B: Ya lo hemos dicho antes, y ahora lo repito: si alguien {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncia un evangelio distinto del que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}, que quede bajo la maldición de Dios.
es.R: Ya {{plural_you:se|os}} lo dijimos antes, y ahora {{plural_you:se|os}} lo vuelvo a decir. Si alguien {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncia una buena noticia diferente de la que {{plural_you:aceptaron|aceptasteis}}, ¡que la maldición de Dios caiga sobre esa persona!

sw.L: Kama tulivyosema kabla, hata sasa nasema tena: mtu yeyote akiwahubiria Injili iliyo kinyume na ile mliyoipokea, na alaaniwe.
sw.B: Tumekwisha kusema hapo awali, na sasa nasema tena: mtu yeyote akiwahubiria Injili tofauti na ile mliyoipokea, huyo na awe chini ya laana ya Mungu.
sw.R: Tuliwaambia jambo hili hapo kwanza, na sasa nawaambia tena. Mtu yeyote akiwaambia habari njema iliyo tofauti na Habari Njema mliyoikubali, laana ya Mungu na imwangukie!

fr.L: Comme nous l’avons déjà dit, maintenant encore je le dis : si quelqu’un vous annonce un évangile contraire à celui que vous avez reçu, qu’il soit maudit.
fr.B: Nous l’avons déjà dit, et maintenant je le répète : si quelqu’un vous annonce un évangile autre que celui que vous avez reçu, que celui-là soit sous la malédiction de Dieu.
fr.R: Nous vous l’avons déjà dit, et maintenant je vous le redis. Si quelqu’un vous annonce une bonne nouvelle différente de celle que vous avez acceptée, que la malédiction de Dieu tombe sur lui !

ko.L: 우리가 전에 말한 것처럼 이제 내가 다시 말합니다. 누구든지 여러분이 받은 것과 다른 복음을 여러분에게 전하고 있다면, 그 사람은 저주를 받아야 합니다.
ko.B: 우리가 전에도 말했지만, 이제 다시 말합니다. 누구든지 여러분이 받은 복음과 다른 복음을 여러분에게 전한다면, 그 사람은 하나님의 저주 아래 놓여야 합니다.
ko.R: 우리는 전에도 여러분에게 이 말을 했고, 지금 다시 말합니다. 누구든지 여러분이 받아들인 기쁜 소식과 다른 기쁜 소식을 여러분에게 전한다면, 하나님의 저주가 그에게 내리기를 바랍니다!

vi.L: Như chúng tôi đã nói trước, bây giờ tôi lại nói nữa: nếu có ai rao giảng cho anh chị em một tin lành trái với điều anh chị em đã nhận, người ấy phải bị nguyền rủa.
vi.B: Chúng tôi đã nói điều này trước đây, và bây giờ tôi xin nói lại: nếu có ai rao giảng cho anh chị em một tin lành khác với Tin Lành anh chị em đã tiếp nhận, thì người ấy phải chịu sự nguyền rủa của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Chúng tôi đã nói với anh chị em điều này trước đây, và bây giờ tôi nói lại. Nếu có ai nói với anh chị em một tin lành khác với Tin Lành anh chị em đã tiếp nhận, nguyện sự nguyền rủa của Đức Chúa Trời đổ trên người ấy!

decisions.choice: as we have said before: most likely when Paul was with them, though it may point back to verse 8
decisions.reason: προειρήκαμεν is a perfect, "we have said before", and Paul sets it against "now again I say". That contrast fits a warning given during his earlier visit better than one written a sentence ago. The words keep both readings open.

decisions.choice: if anyone is preaching: no longer a supposition but what is actually happening
decisions.reason: Verse 8 used ἐὰν with the subjunctive ("if ... should"); verse 9 uses εἴ with the indicative, stating a real case: someone is preaching another gospel to the Galatians now.

decisions.choice: received: took over a message handed on to them, as a tradition is received
decisions.reason: παραλαμβάνω is the word Paul uses for receiving the gospel as something passed on (1 Corinthians 15:1-3). It turns the warning toward the Galatians: the gospel is the one they themselves accepted.

decisions.choice: let that one be accursed (L); let that one be under God's curse (B); may God's curse fall on them (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 8.

decisions.choice: tells you good news
decisions.reason: Readable uses "tell the good news" for the verb throughout Galatians.

decisions.choice: "đã nhận" (L); "đã tiếp nhận" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for receiving a tradition handed on (m3). "Tiếp nhận" says that they took it to themselves, as one receives what is passed on.

source.text: Ἄρτι γὰρ ἀνθρώπους πείθω ἢ τὸν θεόν;

records.literal_gloss: Now for men am I persuading, or the God?

en.L: For am I now winning over human beings, or God?
en.B: Is it people I am trying to win over now, or God?
en.R: So, am I now trying to win people over? Or am I trying to win God's approval?

es.L: Porque, ¿estoy ahora ganándome a los seres humanos, o a Dios?
es.B: ¿Es a la gente a quien intento ganarme ahora, o a Dios?
es.R: Entonces, ¿estoy tratando ahora de ganarme a la gente? ¿O estoy tratando de ganarme la aprobación de Dios?

sw.L: Kwa maana je, sasa ninawavuta wanadamu [upande wangu], au Mungu?
sw.B: Je, ni watu ninaojaribu kuwavuta upande wangu sasa, au ni Mungu?
sw.R: Basi, je, sasa ninajaribu kuwafanya watu wanikubali? Au ninajaribu kupata kibali cha Mungu?

fr.L: Car est-ce maintenant des {{gender:humains|hommes}} que je cherche à gagner, ou Dieu ?
fr.B: Maintenant, qui est-ce que je cherche à gagner : les gens, ou Dieu ?
fr.R: Alors, est-ce que j’essaie maintenant de gagner l’approbation des gens ? Ou est-ce que je cherche l’approbation de Dieu ?

ko.L: 내가 지금 사람들의 마음을 얻으려 합니까, 아니면 하나님의 [마음을 얻으려 합니까]?
ko.B: 내가 지금 사람들의 마음을 얻으려고 애쓰는 것입니까, 아니면 하나님의 마음을 얻으려고 애쓰는 것입니까?
ko.R: 그러면 내가 지금 사람들의 마음을 얻으려고 하는 것입니까? 아니면 하나님께 인정을 받으려고 하는 것입니까?

vi.L: Vì bây giờ tôi đang tìm cách thuyết phục loài người, hay Đức Chúa Trời?
vi.B: Bây giờ tôi đang tìm cách lấy lòng người ta, hay lấy lòng Đức Chúa Trời?
vi.R: Vậy, bây giờ tôi đang cố làm cho người ta ưa thích mình chăng? Hay tôi đang tìm sự chấp nhận của Đức Chúa Trời?

decisions.choice: trying to win over: seeking someone's favor
decisions.reason: πείθω here means to try to win someone over. No one argues God round, so the sense is seeking favor, as the next question ("seeking to please") shows. Paul may be answering a charge that he had made the gospel easy in order to win people (compare 5:11).

decisions.choice: now, after such a curse: these strong words show Paul is not courting anyone's favor
alternatives: "now" contrasts with Paul's life before he met Christ
decisions.reason: γὰρ links the question to the curses just spoken: a man who says that is hardly flattering his hearers. Ἄρτι ("now") points to what he has just written.

decisions.choice: winning over (L); trying to win over (B)
decisions.reason: The present tense describes an attempt; "win over" covers both people and God without suggesting an argument with God.

decisions.choice: Or am I trying to win God's approval?
decisions.reason: Readable writes out the second half of the question.

decisions.choice: kuvuta upande wangu
decisions.reason: "Kushawishi" is to persuade by argument, and the meaning decision rules that out, since no one argues God round. "Kuvuta upande wangu" (draw to my side) is winning someone over and fits both people and God.

decisions.choice: des {{gender:humains|hommes}} (L, and in the next two sentences); les gens (B, R), with no span
decisions.reason: As in 1:1: Literal needs a noun for human beings and carries the setting; "les gens" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "loài người" (L), "người ta" (B, R), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: "Loài người" and "người ta" already include men and women (m2 in 1:1), so the English gender setting has nothing to change in Vietnamese, here and through the letter.

records.literal_gloss: Or do I seek men to please?

en.L: Or am I seeking to please human beings?
en.B: Or is my aim to please people?
en.R: Is my goal to make people happy with me?

es.L: ¿O busco agradar a los seres humanos?
es.B: ¿O es mi propósito agradar a la gente?
es.R: ¿Es mi meta que la gente esté contenta conmigo?

sw.B: Au je, lengo langu ni kuwapendeza watu?
sw.R: Je, lengo langu ni watu wapendezwe nami?

fr.L: Ou est-ce que je cherche à plaire aux {{gender:humains|hommes}} ?
fr.B: Ou bien mon but est-il de plaire aux gens ?
fr.R: Est-ce que je veux que les gens soient contents de moi ?

ko.L: 아니면 내가 사람들을 기쁘게 하려고 구하고 있습니까?
ko.B: 아니면 내 목표가 사람들을 기쁘게 하는 것입니까?
ko.R: 내 목표가 사람들이 나를 좋아하게 만드는 것입니까?

vi.L: Hay tôi đang tìm cách làm vừa lòng loài người?
vi.B: Hay mục đích của tôi là làm vừa lòng người ta?
vi.R: Mục đích của tôi có phải là làm cho người ta hài lòng về mình không?

decisions.choice: a question expecting the answer no
decisions.reason: Paul's second question restates the first in plainer terms. The next sentence gives his answer.

decisions.choice: seeking to please (L); is my aim to please (B); is my goal to make people happy with me (R)
decisions.reason: ζητῶ is "seek"; Balanced and Readable say it as an aim.

source.text: εἰ ἔτι ἀνθρώποις ἤρεσκον, Χριστοῦ δοῦλος οὐκ ἂν ἤμην.

records.literal_gloss: If still men I were pleasing, of Christ slave not would I be.

en.L: If I were still pleasing human beings, I would not be a slave of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: If I were still out to please people, I would be no servant of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: If I were still trying to make people happy with me, I would not be a servant who belongs to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: Si todavía agradara a los seres humanos, no sería esclavo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.B: Si todavía quisiera agradar a la gente, no sería siervo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.R: Si todavía tratara de que la gente estuviera contenta conmigo, no sería un siervo que pertenece {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kama ningekuwa bado ninawapendeza wanadamu, nisingekuwa mtumwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Kama bado ningekuwa ninatafuta kuwapendeza watu, nisingekuwa mtumishi wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Kama bado ningekuwa ninajaribu kuwafanya watu wapendezwe nami, nisingekuwa mtumishi aliye wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Si je plaisais encore aux {{gender:humains|hommes}}, je ne serais pas esclave du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Si je cherchais encore à plaire aux gens, je ne serais pas serviteur du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Si j’essayais encore de rendre les gens contents de moi, je ne serais pas un serviteur qui appartient au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

ko.L: 만일 내가 아직도 사람들을 기쁘게 하고 있다면, 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 종이 아닐 것입니다.
ko.B: 내가 아직도 사람들을 기쁘게 하려 한다면, 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 종이 아닐 것입니다.
ko.R: 내가 아직도 사람들이 나를 좋아하게 만들려고 한다면, 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속한 종이 아닐 것입니다.

vi.L: Nếu tôi còn làm vừa lòng loài người, thì tôi không phải là nô lệ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Nếu tôi vẫn còn tìm cách làm vừa lòng người ta, thì tôi đã không phải là đầy tớ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Nếu tôi vẫn còn cố làm cho người ta hài lòng về mình, thì tôi đã không phải là đầy tớ thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

decisions.choice: a condition contrary to fact: Paul is not pleasing people, and he is Christ's slave
decisions.reason: The past tenses with ἂν state what would be true if the condition were met, implying that it is not.

decisions.choice: still: as Paul once did, before Christ called him
alternatives: simply "any longer", with no reference to his past
decisions.reason: ἔτι implies a time when Paul did seek human approval. Verses 13-14 describe his earlier zeal in Judaism, which won him standing among his people. The word may also be a plain "any longer".

decisions.choice: slave: someone owned by a master and wholly at his service
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 1:1, δοῦλος is a slave. A slave serves one master; a man owned by Christ cannot also make pleasing people his aim.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m3) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: siervo
decisions.reason: "Siervo" in Balanced and Readable, following the English style guide; the meaning decision (m3) keeps that Paul was owned by Christ, and Literal keeps "esclavo".

decisions.choice: mtumishi
decisions.reason: "Mtumishi" in Balanced and Readable, following the English style guide; the meaning decision (m3) keeps that Paul was owned by Christ, and Literal keeps "mtumwa".

decisions.choice: esclave (L); serviteur (B, R) (for the whole letter, except where slavery itself is the point)
decisions.reason: As the French style guide and the English have it: the meaning decision keeps that the man was owned (m3), Literal keeps "esclave", and Balanced and Readable say "serviteur". Galatians 3:28, 4:1-9, 4:21-5:1 keep "esclave" at every level, where slave is set against free or against son.

decisions.choice: "종" at every level, here and through the letter; "노예" where slavery itself is the point (3:28; 4:1-9, 4:21-5:1)
alternatives: "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 섬기는 사람" in Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The English has "slave" in Literal and "servant" in Balanced and Readable. Korean "종" already says that a person belongs wholly to a master, without the picture of modern slavery that "노예" brings, so the Korean style guide keeps the one word at every level, as in Colossians and Romans. "노예" is kept for the places where slavery and freedom are themselves the point.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R) for doulos (for the whole letter, except where slavery itself is the point)
decisions.reason: As in the English and the Vietnamese Colossians, Literal keeps "slave", one owned by a master (m3), and Balanced and Readable say "đầy tớ" (servant). Where Paul sets slave against free or speaks of slavery under the law (3:28; 4:1-9; 4:21-5:1), "nô lệ" stays at every level.

source.text: Γνωρίζω γὰρ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν ὑπ’ ἐμοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ ἄνθρωπον·

records.literal_gloss: I make known for to you, brothers, the gospel the [one] having been preached by me, that not it is according to man;

en.L: For I make known to you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, the gospel that was preached by me, that it is not of human [origin];
en.B: For I want you to know, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, that the gospel I preached is no human invention.
en.R: My {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I want you to understand this. The good news I told you is not something people made up.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} hago saber, hermanos, el evangelio que fue anunciado por mí, que no es de [origen] humano;
es.B: Porque quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}}, hermanos, que el evangelio que yo anuncié no es invención humana.
es.R: Hermanos míos, quiero que {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} esto. La buena noticia que {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié no es algo inventado por la gente.

sw.L: Kwa maana nawajulisha, ndugu, Injili iliyohubiriwa nami, kwamba si ya [asili ya] kibinadamu;
sw.B: Kwa maana nataka mjue, ndugu, kwamba Injili niliyoihubiri si jambo lililobuniwa na wanadamu.
sw.R: Ndugu zangu, nataka mwelewe jambo hili. Habari Njema niliyowaambia si kitu ambacho watu walikitunga.

fr.L: Car je vous fais savoir, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, que l’Évangile qui a été annoncé par moi n’est pas [d’origine] humaine ;
fr.B: Car je veux que vous le sachiez, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} : l’Évangile que j’ai annoncé n’est pas une invention humaine.
fr.R: Mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je veux que vous compreniez bien ceci : la bonne nouvelle que je vous ai annoncée n’a pas été inventée par des gens.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 내가 여러분에게 알려 드립니다. 내가 전한 복음은 사람을 따른 [것]이 아닙니다.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 여러분이 알기를 바랍니다. 내가 전한 복음은 사람이 지어낸 것이 아닙니다.
ko.R: 사랑하는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 이것을 꼭 알아 두십시오. 내가 여러분에게 전한 기쁜 소식은 사람들이 만들어 낸 것이 아닙니다.

vi.L: Vì, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi cho anh chị em biết rằng Tin Lành mà tôi đã rao giảng không phải theo loài người;
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn anh chị em biết rằng Tin Lành tôi đã rao giảng không phải do loài người đặt ra.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn anh chị em hiểu điều này: Tin Lành tôi đã nói với anh chị em không phải là điều do con người bịa ra.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "for"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts are divided between γὰρ ("for") and a weaker connecting word ("but, now"). With "for", Paul explains why he is no people-pleaser (verse 10); with the other, he simply begins a new section. The statement itself is the same.

decisions.choice: I make known to you: a solemn opening for an important statement
alternatives: I am telling you something new
decisions.reason: Γνωρίζω introduces a statement Paul wants the readers to take to heart (1 Corinthians 15:1; 2 Corinthians 8:1). The Galatians already knew his gospel; he is stating where it came from.

decisions.choice: not human: not of human origin, and so not shaped by human standards
decisions.reason: κατὰ ἄνθρωπον can mean "by human standards" (1 Corinthians 3:3) or "from a human source". Verse 12 explains it in terms of source: Paul did not receive the gospel from any person. Origin is the main point, with its character following from it.

decisions.choice: brothers and sisters: the believers of the Galatian churches, men and women
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοί is masculine plural, the ordinary way to address a mixed group.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Gender setting, as in 1:2.

decisions.choice: of human [origin] (L); no human invention (B); not something people made up (R)
decisions.reason: "According to man" is not clear English. The levels say what the phrase means here (m3).

decisions.choice: "{{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분" for the address, through the letter
decisions.reason: As in Romans: "형제자매" is the inclusive default for a church of men and women, "형제" the traditional form, and "여러분" keeps the respectful address of the letter. The older vocative "-이여" is not used. Readable adds "사랑하는", as the English Readable adds "my", to keep the warmth of the address.

decisions.choice: "thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" for the address (through the letter)
decisions.reason: "Thưa" is the respectful modern way to address a group in a letter read aloud, as in the Vietnamese Romans (1:13); "hỡi" belongs to older and liturgical speech. Paul's address is in the vocative only, with no "my" in the Greek, so the English Readable "My" is not followed.

decisions.choice: the address "thưa anh chị em" after "Vì" (L)
alternatives: the address in the middle, as in the Greek
decisions.reason: Vietnamese puts the address near the head of the sentence; in the middle it would follow "anh chị em" (you) and read as the same word twice, as the Vietnamese Romans notes (7:1).

source.text: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐγὼ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου παρέλαβον αὐτό, οὔτε ἐδιδάχθην, ἀλλὰ δι’ ἀποκαλύψεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Not-even for I from man received it, nor was I taught [it], but through revelation of Jesus Christ.

en.L: For I did not receive it from a human being, nor was I taught [it], but [I received it] through a revelation of Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: I did not receive it from any human being, and nobody taught it to me. It came to me through a revelation of Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: No person gave it to me, and no one taught it to me. Instead, God showed Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} to me, and that is how I received it.

es.L: Porque yo tampoco lo recibí de un ser humano, ni me fue enseñado, sino [que lo recibí] por medio de una revelación de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: No lo recibí de ningún ser humano, y nadie me lo enseñó. Me llegó por medio de una revelación de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Ninguna persona me la dio, y nadie me la enseñó. Al contrario, Dios me mostró a {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, y así fue como la recibí.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi sikuipokea kutoka kwa mwanadamu, wala sikufundishwa, bali [niliipokea] kupitia ufunuo wa Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Sikuipokea kutoka kwa mwanadamu yeyote, wala hakuna aliyenifundisha. Ilinijia kupitia ufunuo wa Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu aliyenipa, na hakuna aliyenifundisha. Badala yake, Mungu alinionyesha Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na hivyo ndivyo nilivyoipokea.

fr.L: Car moi non plus, je ne l’ai pas reçu d’un {{gender:être humain|homme}}, et on ne me l’a pas enseigné, mais [je l’ai reçu] par une révélation de Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Je ne l’ai reçu de personne, et personne ne me l’a enseigné : il m’est venu par une révélation de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Personne ne me l’a donnée, et personne ne me l’a enseignée. C’est Dieu qui m’a montré Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, et c’est ainsi que je l’ai reçue.

ko.L: 나는 그것을 사람에게서 받지도 않았고 배우지도 않았으며, 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 계시를 통하여 [받았습니다].
ko.B: 나는 이 복음을 어떤 사람에게서 받지도 않았고, 누구에게서 배우지도 않았습니다. 이 복음은 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 계시를 통해 나에게 왔습니다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 그것을 나에게 준 것도 아니고, 누가 가르쳐 준 것도 아닙니다. 하나님께서 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 나에게 보여 주셨고, 그렇게 해서 나는 그것을 받았습니다.

vi.L: Vì tôi đã không nhận nó từ một người nào, cũng không được ai dạy, nhưng [đã nhận] qua sự mặc khải của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Tôi không nhận Tin Lành ấy từ một người nào, cũng không ai dạy cho tôi. Tin Lành ấy đến với tôi qua sự mặc khải của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Không ai trao Tin Lành ấy cho tôi, và cũng không ai dạy cho tôi. Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã bày tỏ Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} cho tôi, và đó là cách tôi đã nhận được Tin Lành.

decisions.choice: received ... taught: Paul did not get the gospel as a tradition handed down or as lessons from a teacher
decisions.reason: παραλαμβάνω is the word for receiving teaching handed on (1:9; 1 Corinthians 15:3), and διδάσκω for learning it from a teacher. Paul does not deny that he later learned facts from others (1:18); he denies that his gospel and its authority came that way.

decisions.choice: a revelation of Jesus Christ: God's unveiling of Jesus Christ to Paul
alternatives: a revelation from Jesus Christ (Jesus is the one who revealed it)
decisions.reason: After ἀποκαλύψεως the name can be what was revealed or who revealed it. Verse 16 says God was pleased "to reveal his Son" to Paul, which favors Jesus Christ as the one revealed. But the risen Jesus also spoke to Paul (Acts 9:4-6), and the other reading is fully possible. Either way the gospel came to Paul straight from heaven, not from people.

decisions.choice: the revelation Paul received when the risen Jesus appeared to him near Damascus
decisions.reason: ἀποκάλυψις is an unveiling of what was hidden. Paul places it just before his return to Damascus (1:15-17); Acts 9 tells the story, and 1 Corinthians 15:8 counts it as an appearance of the risen Jesus.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: but [I received it] through
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the verb the Greek carries over from the first clause.

decisions.choice: Instead, God showed Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} to me, and that is how I received it.
alternatives: but through a revelation of Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: Readable says what the revelation was, following the reading chosen in m2 and verse 16.

decisions.choice: on ne me l'a pas enseigné (L); personne ne me l'a enseigné (B, R)
alternatives: je n'en ai pas été instruit
decisions.reason: French does not make the person taught the subject of a passive "enseigner", so the passive "nor was I taught" becomes an active sentence, as in Colossians 2:7. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: "예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 계시" (L, B); "하나님께서 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 나에게 보여 주셨고" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as God unveiling Jesus Christ to Paul, with Christ as the one who reveals as the other reading. Korean "...의 계시" keeps both open at Literal and Balanced, as the Greek does; Readable says the reading chosen, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "sự mặc khải" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời đã bày tỏ" (R)
decisions.reason: "Mặc khải" is the Vietnamese church word for God unveiling what was hidden, and keeps the open phrase of m2 ("of Jesus Christ"); Readable says it with the plain verb "bày tỏ", as the English Readable says God showed Jesus to Paul.

source.text: Ἠκούσατε γὰρ τὴν ἐμὴν ἀναστροφήν ποτε ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ, ὅτι καθ’ ὑπερβολὴν ἐδίωκον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπόρθουν αὐτήν, καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν τῷ γένει μου, περισσοτέρως ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τῶν πατρικῶν μου παραδόσεων.

records.literal_gloss: You heard for of the my way-of-life formerly in the Judaism, that beyond measure I was persecuting the church of the God and was destroying it, \v 14 and I was advancing in the Judaism beyond many contemporaries in the race of me, more abundantly zealous being of the ancestral of me traditions.

en.L: For you have heard of my way of life formerly in Judaism, that beyond measure I was persecuting the church of God and trying to destroy it, \v 14 and I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people, being far more zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
en.B: You have heard about the way I once lived in Judaism: how fiercely I persecuted God's church and set out to destroy it. \v 14 I was moving ahead in Judaism faster than many people my age among my own people, because I was far more zealous for the traditions handed down from my ancestors.
en.R: You have heard how I used to live when I was devoted to Judaism, the Jewish way of life. I attacked God's church with great violence. I tried to wipe it out. \v 14 I was going further in Judaism than many others my age among my people. I was much more eager than they were to keep the traditions handed down from my ancestors.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:han|habéis}} oído de mi manera de vivir en otro tiempo en el judaísmo, que perseguía sobremanera a la iglesia de Dios y trataba de destruirla, \v 14 y avanzaba en el judaísmo más que muchos de mi edad entre los de mi pueblo, siendo extremadamente celoso de las tradiciones de mis padres.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} oído cómo vivía yo antes en el judaísmo: con qué furia perseguía a la iglesia de Dios y me proponía destruirla. \v 14 Avanzaba en el judaísmo más que muchos de mi edad en mi pueblo, porque defendía con mucho más celo las tradiciones heredadas de mis antepasados.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} oído cómo vivía yo cuando estaba entregado al judaísmo, la forma de vida judía. Atacaba a la iglesia de Dios con gran violencia. Trataba de acabar con ella. \v 14 Iba más lejos en el judaísmo que muchos otros de mi edad en mi pueblo. Tenía mucho más empeño que ellos en cumplir las tradiciones que venían de mis antepasados.

sw.L: Kwa maana mmesikia habari za mwenendo wangu wa zamani katika Uyahudi, kwamba nilikuwa nikilitesa kanisa la Mungu kupita kiasi na kujaribu kuliangamiza, \v 14 nami nilikuwa nikiendelea katika Uyahudi kupita wengi wa rika langu katika taifa langu, nikiwa na ari kubwa zaidi kwa ajili ya mapokeo ya baba zangu.
sw.B: Mmesikia jinsi nilivyoishi zamani katika Uyahudi: jinsi nilivyolitesa kanisa la Mungu kwa ukali mkubwa na kujaribu kuliangamiza. \v 14 Nilikuwa nikisonga mbele katika Uyahudi kuliko wengi wa rika langu katika taifa langu, kwa sababu nilikuwa na ari kubwa zaidi kwa mapokeo niliyorithi kutoka kwa mababu zangu.
sw.R: Mmesikia jinsi nilivyoishi zamani nilipokuwa nimejitoa kwa Uyahudi, yaani njia ya maisha ya Wayahudi. Nililishambulia kanisa la Mungu kwa ukatili mkubwa. Nilijaribu kulifuta kabisa. \v 14 Nilikuwa nimeendelea katika Uyahudi kuliko wengine wengi wa rika langu katika taifa langu. Nilikuwa na hamu kubwa zaidi kuliko wao ya kushika mapokeo niliyorithi kutoka kwa mababu zangu.

fr.L: Car vous avez entendu parler de ma conduite d’autrefois dans le judaïsme : à l’excès je persécutais l’Église de Dieu et je la dévastais, \v 14 et je progressais dans le judaïsme plus que beaucoup de ceux de mon âge dans mon peuple, étant extrêmement zélé pour les traditions de mes pères.
fr.B: Vous avez entendu parler de la vie que je menais autrefois dans le judaïsme : avec quelle violence je persécutais l’Église de Dieu et je m’acharnais à la détruire. \v 14 Dans le judaïsme, j’allais plus loin que beaucoup de ceux de mon âge parmi mon peuple, car j’étais bien plus zélé qu’eux pour les traditions reçues de mes ancêtres.
fr.R: Vous avez entendu comment je vivais autrefois, quand j’étais très attaché au judaïsme, la façon de vivre des Juifs. J’attaquais l’Église de Dieu avec une grande violence. J’essayais de la faire disparaître. \v 14 J’allais plus loin dans le judaïsme que beaucoup d’autres de mon âge dans mon peuple. Je voulais, bien plus qu’eux, obéir aux traditions transmises par mes ancêtres.

ko.L: 여러분은 전에 유대교 안에 있을 때의 나의 생활 방식에 대하여 들었습니다. 곧 내가 하나님의 교회를 지나치게 박해하며 그것을 없애려 하였고, \v 14 내 민족 가운데 나와 같은 나이의 많은 사람들보다 유대교에서 앞서 나갔으며, 내 조상들의 전통에 대하여 훨씬 더 열심이 있었다는 것입니다.
ko.B: 내가 전에 유대교에 몸담고 있을 때 어떻게 살았는지 여러분은 들었습니다. 나는 하나님의 교회를 몹시 박해했고, 교회를 없애 버리려고 했습니다. \v 14 나는 조상들에게서 내려온 전통을 지키는 데 누구보다 열심이었기 때문에, 내 민족 가운데 같은 나이의 많은 사람들보다 유대교에서 더 앞서 나갔습니다.
ko.R: 내가 전에 유대교, 곧 유대인의 생활 방식에 깊이 빠져 있을 때 어떻게 살았는지 여러분은 들었습니다. 나는 아주 난폭하게 하나님의 교회를 공격했습니다. 교회를 완전히 없애 버리려고 했습니다. \v 14 나는 내 민족 가운데 같은 나이의 많은 사람들보다 유대교에서 더 앞서 나갔습니다. 조상들에게서 내려온 전통을 지키는 일에 그들보다 훨씬 더 열심이었습니다.

vi.L: Vì anh chị em đã nghe về nếp sống của tôi trước kia trong đạo Do Thái, rằng tôi đã bắt bớ Hội Thánh của Đức Chúa Trời quá mức và tìm cách hủy diệt Hội Thánh, \v 14 và tôi đã tiến xa trong đạo Do Thái hơn nhiều người cùng tuổi trong dân tộc tôi, vì tôi nhiệt thành hơn hẳn đối với các truyền thống của tổ tiên tôi.
vi.B: Anh chị em đã nghe về cách tôi sống trước kia trong đạo Do Thái: tôi đã bắt bớ Hội Thánh của Đức Chúa Trời cách dữ dội và tìm cách hủy diệt Hội Thánh. \v 14 Tôi đã tiến bộ trong đạo Do Thái hơn nhiều người cùng lứa tuổi trong dân tộc tôi, vì tôi nhiệt thành hơn hẳn đối với các truyền thống của tổ tiên truyền lại.
vi.R: Anh chị em đã nghe tôi sống thế nào khi tôi còn hết lòng theo đạo Do Thái, tức là lối sống của người Do Thái. Tôi đã tấn công Hội Thánh của Đức Chúa Trời cách hung bạo. Tôi đã tìm cách tiêu diệt Hội Thánh. \v 14 Tôi đã đi xa trong đạo Do Thái hơn nhiều người cùng tuổi trong dân tộc tôi. Tôi hăng hái hơn họ rất nhiều trong việc giữ các truyền thống của tổ tiên truyền lại.

decisions.choice: Judaism: the Jewish way of life, practiced in strict loyalty to the law and the customs of the people
alternatives: a religion separate from faith in Christ, in the modern sense
decisions.reason: Ἰουδαϊσμός is a rare word, used in Jewish writings of the time for holding firmly to Jewish ways against foreign customs (2 Maccabees 2:21; 8:1). Paul does not stop being a Jew (2:15); what he left behind is the zeal of that way of life as the measure of standing with God.

decisions.choice: I kept persecuting the church and was trying to destroy it
decisions.reason: Both verbs are imperfect: they describe something repeated over a time. πορθέω was used of sacking a city; the imperfect shows an attempt that did not succeed, as verse 23 confirms.

decisions.choice: the church of God: God's people gathered in Christ, the whole body Paul attacked
decisions.reason: Paul uses ἐκκλησία for a local congregation (1:2) and for God's people as a whole, as here (1 Corinthians 15:9).

decisions.choice: zealous: fiercely devoted, ready to act against anyone who broke the law
alternatives: a member of the Zealot party
decisions.reason: ζηλωτής recalls Phinehas and Elijah, who acted with violence for God's honor (Numbers 25:11-13; 1 Kings 19:10). Paul's zeal explains his persecution (Philippians 3:6). There is no sign he means the later political party.

decisions.choice: the traditions of my fathers: the teaching handed down among the Pharisees alongside the written law
decisions.reason: Paul was a Pharisee (Philippians 3:5). The Pharisees kept παράδοσις, rules and interpretations passed down from earlier teachers (Mark 7:3-5).

decisions.choice: my contemporaries among my people: Jews of Paul's own age
decisions.reason: συνηλικιώτης means someone of the same age; γένος here is Paul's people, the Jews.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "my fathers"; Balanced and Readable use the plain English word for the generations before.

decisions.choice: Judaism, the Jewish way of life
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word as m1 describes it, so that it is not read as a separate religion.

decisions.choice: fiercely (B); with great violence (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means to an extreme degree; the context is violent persecution.

decisions.choice: Uyahudi
decisions.reason: "Dini ya Kiyahudi" (the Jewish religion) would suggest a religion separate from faith in Christ, which the meaning decision rules out. "Uyahudi" names the Jewish way of life, and Readable explains it as "njia ya maisha ya Wayahudi". Because "Uyahudi" is also an older name for Judea, verse 22 calls the region "Yudea".

decisions.choice: ari
